causal_controls.baseline: Same acquired host with all8 cases; fixed host query/drive and actual witnessed bank copied immutably for each intervention. No model learning.
causal_controls.flip_A_and_flip_B: Separate donor panels from the actual counterpart case that changes one named binary value only. Transplant that record K and V together, preserving its name/age; both heads see the complete bank. Correct donor pair follow>=.80 (at least7/8), with other-slot answers unchanged.
causal_controls.limits: Head lesions remove restoring coupling too; clone and interface interventions change cortical transport as well as selectors. A single head can encode both facts in an analog mixture. No information-theoretic need for two heads is claimed.
causal_controls.parallel_claim: Separate distinct-useful-head flag requires qualified complete head/clone/interface panels. On each of4unequal rows independently, heads favor opposite actual named records, favored mass>=.50 and margin>=.10; no permanent head-to-name assignment. BEFORE lesion choose each row head-preferred A/B by argmax(A_mass,B_mass), deterministic A on tie, including equal-value rows; compare accuracy of that named outputslot before/after the head lesion OVERALL8, loss>=.20(at least2/8). Equal-row name assignment is observationally ambiguous; report unequal4 predicted-slot loss separately, descriptive only. Each head lesion and clone pair loss>=.20 overall8; frozen/shuffled interface pair loss>=.20 overall8. No head-count advantage without separate matched resource controls.
causal_controls.record_erasures: Erase each named record separately. Relevant output-slot accuracy loss>=.20 (at least2/8); refusal is not a loss effect.
causal_controls.shams: Neutral record change, matched K/V/held/age reorder and algebraic head-descriptor order. Pair-answer change<=.05 (zero of8).

claims.scope: At most a measured small-task acquisition/content-use prerequisite. Several task difficulties were removed, so a positive outcome does not identify the original failure's cause.

protocol.equation: Existing agreement, totalalpha3 split over heads; empty_anchor=true. Keep the same immutable bank and live query/read/cortex through full-field qualification and bounded damping.

execution.accounting: Each stage is additional with the listed total/per-training-call bounds, including verification/construction/arrays/all attempted phases and refusals. Check deadlines between rounds and panels; retain bounded final round/panel overrun. Costs inherit prior cumulative exactly once.
execution.condition: Explicit serial CLI stage after focused tests, independent review and source freeze; no automatic stage launch. Capacity first; H2 only after positive matched capacity. No additional confirmation gate.

future_head_benefit_assessment.accuracy: For EACH founder, H2 exact-pair accuracy must exceed EACH of the four matched control accuracies by at least .10. With8cases this requires at least one additional correct pair(1/8). No cherry-picked arm/seed/row.
future_head_benefit_assessment.boundaries: No original four-value/query-permutation/held-pair transfer, learned meaning, continuing-life, fresh confirmation or Stone Age claim. Several task difficulties were jointly removed.
future_head_benefit_assessment.requires: Both H2 founders pass primary,256-round retention and distinct-useful-head assessment. A separately authorized/frozen future stage must complete all8 matched q1 H1,H1-width,H1-port-copies,H1-work controls, bothfounders, without capped/refused/unrun readings. Controls need complete512-round training and qualified measured panels, but do NOT need .95 acquisition (that failure is reported). Missing or unqualified controls mean unknown, never advantage.
future_head_benefit_assessment.resources: Only claim matched-work or efficiency when complete actual transport, softmax, sweep/row and host counters are retained for all compared cells; disclose unequal costs. No head-advantage claim follows from primary or distinct-usefulness flags alone.
future_head_benefit_assessment.status: preregistered interpretation only; no comparator stage is implemented or opened by this wrapper

protocol.initialization: Use the existing ordinary query-seam initializer once before the first event. Separate SeedSequence([founder,head]).spawn(1)[0] streams; no q0 search, role label or selector teaching. Require actual initializer records and initial parameter digests.
protocol.integration_warning: Functions accept the old four-column case shape where meaningful. panel('held_out') deliberately refuses. Reuse old low-level prepare/train/evaluate on explicitly supplied8-case rows if desired; their original score schema and whole-trial/held/probe gates must not be silently reused. A new wrapper must recompute this task's actual scores and own its prerequisites.

prior.requires: Source-verified actual negative q1 H2 receipt before new construction; old task and capacity remain separate.

protocol.query_boundary: Clear working trace and warm activity after the actual prefix; retain its bank. Explicit component boundary, not an ongoing-life policy.

active_binary.role: Primary task-aware uniform reference; retain its actual sampled answers and scores.

full_motor.role: Separate full-motor uniform reference; inactive choices remain possible errors.

retention.gate: Complete all256 rounds with zero refusals; .95 on all8 and loss<=.05 allows no loss from8/8. No interference, held-transfer or life claim.
retention.schedule: Existing balanced cyclic construction adapted to the explicit8-case fixed-query task: shuffle all8 once with SeedSequence([622024,founder]), take16 cyclic rows per round for256 rounds; every round contains2copies of each case, query remains0. No held panel or AB/BA alternation.
retention.start: Only after acquisition/content-use passes; same-task continued balanced exposure, no new value pair.

protocol.scope: A smaller raw-input, in-distribution component prerequisite. Both named facts are independently needed in the same final answer. It cannot pass the original four-value/permuted-query/held-pair gates or identify which original difficulty caused failure.
protocol.source_custody: New typed receipts and every parameter snapshot bind helper, task, protocol and every exact old runtime/prior dependency. Direct q1 construction with explicit old factory; old train/prepare receive valid explicit rows, without task/factory monkeypatch. No held panel or old relevance receipt kind. Repeated historical-prior verification arithmetic may be cached only by exact negative-receipt rawSHA plus FULL oldq1H2 source_manifest plus the exact declared prior specification; configure clears it, changedbytes reverify, cachehits return a fresh parsedReceipt. No current capacity/model-state cache. All actual verification host costs remain charged.

capacity.gate: All4 cells complete512 rounds with zero action/lesson refusal and fully answered qualified all8 panels; .95 pair/slot/unequal/prefix floors imply8/8 pairs and4/4 unequal pairs. No held floor/panel exists. Newborn all8 and final all8 panels must both qualify and be fully answered; newborn accuracy is unrestricted. This stricter completeness guard rejects an initial action refusal rather than calling the whole cell refusal-free.
capacity.requires: New matched task/source/q1 controls; old four-value capacity does not admit this task.

h2.gate: Complete512 rounds, no action/lesson refusal, all8 pairs correct; both-fact causal panels qualified and complete. Retention is conditional and required for a retained primary result. Newborn all8 must qualify and answer fully, with accuracy unrestricted; final and required causal panels must qualify.
h2.requires: Both matched capacity founders/arms pass at exact source; attempt both H2 founders and retain each failure.

task.case_order: Lexicographic (A value0/1, B value0/1, prefix order0/1, query0).
task.evaluation: Enumerate all8 cases; pair/slot counts, both4-case prefix marginals and4 unequal cases. No training/evaluation split is claimed. All refusal/unrun/inactive motor answers remain wrong.
task.prefix: IS+A+value_A and IS+B+value_B in the declared order, then one neutral event.
task.query: AMBIGUOUS_CUE+ASK_AB, identical in every candidate case; no value or address.
task.schedule: SeedSequence([622022,founder]); draw with replacement from all8 cases. All compared arms share the exact schedule.
task.target: Always(value_A,value_B), two final action labels only.

protocol.teaching: Capture complete pre-query drive and immutable bank, greedy act, then teach both final labels on wrong-pair rows only. The same selected streams persist through free/positive/negative phases. No learned answer head, selector target, role label or rule change.
